title: program/evidence/<ID>/results/<utc>-<sha256[:12]>.json
description: Appended by pk's evidence kit (Evidence.write), never modified, named by the sha256 of its bytes, named by program/evidence/<ID>/latest.json while it is the task's latest, and checked by `pk evidence validate`. Its inputs never name a derived output (`pk evidence lint`). Only a gate record carries children. The checker enforces the same shape in code; its list of required keys is read from this file. This is the record the hand-back gate, the binding check and `pk status set ... done` accept: they refuse a planted-bug row without path, find, replace, build_argv or test_argv, where `pk evidence validate` alone checks those five only when a row carries them.

head.description: the one commit the evidence binds to

main.description: SHA of the main branch when produced

inputs.description: the sha256 of each input's blob committed at head. Written since 0.4.1 as a list of {path, sha256} objects sorted by path, so no path shares a JSON line with a hex value (a secret scanner's generic-key rule matched a path such as src/auth/token.py next to its digest); a record written before 0.4.1 holds a mapping of path to sha256, and every reader accepts both

argv.description: the literal command, never a shell string

as_expected.description: exit equals expected_exit and any parse succeeded

derived.description: fields parsed from the real output

output_sha256.description: over the full combined stdout and stderr

from_gate_step.description: optional (0.5.2): the row was built from the hand-back gate's own test step, which ran this argv at this head (Evidence.reuse_gate_test)

planted_bugs.description: one row per planted bug, then exactly one self-test row (id self-test-noncompiling, builds false, killed false). Since 0.5.2 a run with more than one worker adds to every row the optional judged: parallel (judged in the pool), serial (a serial row or the self-test row, judged alone) or serial-recheck (a pool verdict that was not a clean kill, judged again alone); pk evidence validate refuses any other value. Since 0.5.3 a row the producer marked defer: true is recorded in its table position as a deferred row (definitions.deferred_row): its full definition, deferred: true and definition_sha256, and no verdict. The gate does not judge it and planted_bugs_all_killed counts only the judged rows; pk gate plants judges it later at this record's head and appends a plants record (plants.schema.json) bound to this record; pk evidence accept, pk status set done and pk merge need every deferred row killed in such a record

killed.description: true only when the code built and the test failed

kill_reason.description: build failed iff builds is false; test failed iff killed; else not killed

path.description: the file the bug was planted in, relative to the root

find.description: the text that was replaced; empty in the self-test row, which appends

replace.description: what it was replaced with; in the self-test row, the appended line

build_argv.description: the build command run on the edited file; null when no build step was given

test_argv.description: the test command whose exit decided killed

planted_bugs_all_killed.description: over the rows except the self-test row

tree_unchanged_by_run.description: clean at the start, clean at the end, same HEAD

supersedes.description: digest of the task's previous latest results record, or null for its first

reused_from.description: optional (0.5.2): the hand-back gate wrote this record by copying the commands and planted-bug rows of the named record, whose head has byte-identical code (evidence.reuse_unchanged_code); head, main, merge_base and inputs are this record's own

plants_reused_from.description: optional (0.5.3), only with reused_from when the reused record deferred planted-bug rows: the plants records bound to the reused record (or to one it reused in turn); judged on the same code, they count for this record too

planted_bugs_timing.description: optional (0.5.3): the wall time of the judged planted-bug rows (the self-test row counted), the rows and the workers; the hand-back gate reads it to warn before a run whose judged rows may not fit the evidence step's limit

children.description: a gate record only: the child records it binds by digest, with each child's drift at the gate's head

deferred_row.description: a planted-bug row deferred to pk gate plants (0.5.3): what to plant and how to judge it, and no verdict

definition_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) of path, find, replace, build_argv, test_argv and serial
